description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.  

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

At Life360, the Marketing team is a highly valued contributor to the business. From creating demand to converting that demand to expanding our relationships with members, the Marketing team is at the forefront of telling the Life360 story and how it can help make everyday family life better. We prioritize bold thinking, principled risks and entrepreneurial thinking. And, we give our marketers the freedom and autonomy to make the decisions they feel are best for the brand and the business. It's an exciting time to be on the Life360 global Marketing team!

About the Job

Reporting to the VP of Integrated Marketing, the Senior Director of Integrated Marketing turns strategy into in-market execution across consumer acquisition, creating demand in the US and in our international priority markets, including (but not limited to) the UK, Australia, Canada and Germany, with additional markets coming online each year. You will partner closely with the Senior Director of Performance Marketing to close the funnel — your work creates the demand, theirs accelerates and converts it, and the two only work as one motion.

You will lead a small but mighty team and a set of agency partners across brand/demand creation media, influencer partnerships,and  sports marketing across both the App and Verticals business units. You own the day-to-day: the plans, the budgets, the channel mix, the campaign calendars and the reporting that tells us what is working. 

The international scope is the part that makes this role different. Each market is at a different stage, with varying points of brand awareness and subscription maturity. Ensuring we are right sizing the strategy to the market stage and delivering flawless execution is key. 

You will partner deeply with marketing leaders across creative and social, product marketing, journey marketing, comms and with functional teams outside marketing (data science and analytics, design, finance) and product/eng teams (subscription growth, devices). Your performance connects directly to the company's key goals — brand, free user growth, and financial — and this is a high visibility role.

The US-based salary range for this position is $171,000 to $266,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You'll Do

  • Build and run bold, distinct consumer marketing campaigns that stand out and help cement Life360 as the #1 app for making everyday family life better.
  • Own integrated plans across the US, UK, AU, CA and DE — deciding what scales globally, what gets localized, and what a single market needs built for it. Driving towards company goals of MAU and QNR.
  • Translate a global brief into market-level media plans, flighting and budgets, working with regional agency partners and in-market teams on local nuance: media landscape, competitive set, cultural context, language and regulatory requirements.
  • Deeply understand how each marketing channel and lever connects to our key brand and business metrics, and enact the strategies and tactics that generate greater returns from our investment in them.
  • Ensure cohesion and orchestration across channels and surfaces, both those managed within and those managed outside of your team.
  • Partner with brand and creative leadership on strong connectivity of messaging, creative excellence, and adherence to brand guidelines and ambition — including creative adaptation and localization for international markets.
  • Partner with business group leaders so Integrated Marketing activity reflects their broader vision and priorities.
  • Own the marketing budget day to day across markets: buildww the plans, track pacing, reallocate as performance dictates, and serve as the VP's right hand on forecast and performance.
  • Partner with Finance and Analytics leadership on performance reporting and actionable insight, with measurement that holds up at both a global and a market level. Run the forums where those insights get shared with leadership and other vested constituents.
  • Lead, coach and grow a high performing team working across time zones, and hold agency partners to a high standard.

What We're Looking For

  • 15+ years of successful experience in full funnel marketing,  ideally with 4+ years in the app marketing space (ideally).
  • Experience running marketing across multiple countries — ideally some combination of the US, UK, Australia, Canada and Germany.
  • Deep knowledge of and experience with brand and demand creation strategies and tactics, and comfortable communicating with senior leaders how creating demand drives business growth.
  • Deep belief in the value of long-term brand building as a complement to more short-term oriented marketing methods, goals and techniques.
  • Consumer subscription experience strongly preferred. Freemium model experience is highly beneficial.
  • Strong understanding of marketing insights and analytics methodologies and tools, from attribution to marketing mix and econometric modeling and beyond — including the practical realities of measuring smaller markets with less data.
  • A strong people leader who builds trust, develops talent, and holds a high bar with care and empathy. 
  • Experience managing agency partners, including regional or local-market agencies.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaborator who can work effectively across time zones.
  • Stellar communicator. Can distill complex stories down and communicate persuasively in both written and verbal modalities.
  • While data-informed, embraces the grayscale nature of marketing and complements empiricism with judgment and intuition.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference 

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. 
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. 
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. 

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.
